69045201.Name: Integrated Phaethon of the Scorched Horizon

69014504.Desc:
· When Integrated - Scorched Horizon is Impaired or Shutdown, the whole squad's <color=#FFAF2C>Sharp DMG increases by 40%</color> for 60s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. 
· When an Agent's attack hits an enemy that is not Stunned, Daze dealt <color=#FFAF2C>increases by 15%</color>. While Integrated - Scorched Horizon is Stunned, the Stun DMG Multiplier <color=#FFAF2C>increases by 20%</color>.

69014505.Desc: · When Integrated - Scorched Horizon is in <color=#FFFFFF>Misty Veil</color> state, using <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to counter Integrated - Scorched Horizon's attack and impair it grants <color=#FFAF2C>1500 Performance Points</color>; landing a <color=#FFAF2C>Shutdown</color> on Integrated - Scorched Horizon's <Term:2000003></Term> grants <color=#FFAF2C>2000 Performance Points</color>. A maximum of 5000 Performance Points can be obtained.

69014502.Title: Cinders of Corrosion
69014502.Desc:
· If there are 2/3 Agents in the squad with the <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> specialty, the whole squad's Anomaly Proficiency <color=#2BAD00>increases by 20/60</color> respectively, and Anomaly Buildup Rate <color=#2BAD00>increases by 10%/20%</color> respectively.
· After an Agent inflicts an <color=#FFFFFF>Attribute Anomaly</color> on an enemy, the enemy's DEF is <color=#2BAD00>reduced by 10%</color> for 10s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

69014503.Title: Gleaming Frost
69014503.Desc:
· Agents with the <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> specialty deal <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> more <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
· Agent CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>. When attacking a Stunned enemy, the enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier additionally increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 20s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

69014603.Title: Sharp Rupture
69014603.Desc:
· Agent PEN Ratio <color=#2BAD00>increases by 5%</color>. When attacks hit enemies, they ignore <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> of enemy <color=#2EB6FF>Electric RES</color>.
· After an Agent uses <color=#FFFFFF>[EX Special Attack]</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>[Special Attack]</color>, Sharp DMG <color=#2BAD00>increases by 20%</color> and DEF <color=#2BAD00>increases by 10%</color> for 20s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

69014506.Desc:

When Kusarikku becomes Stunned, applies 2 stacks of [Exposed]. Each stack of [Exposed] increases the <color=#FFAF2C>Laceration DMG Kusarikku receives by 10%</color>. [Exposed] can stack up to 4 times and lasts <color=#FFAF2C>30</color>s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

69014507.Desc: · After Kusarikku activates Corruptive Barrier, use <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to counter Kusarikku's <Term:2000005></Term> and leave it Impaired to gain <color=#FFAF2C>1000 Performance Points</color>; successfully countering a <Term:2000005></Term> with <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> grants <color=#FFAF2C>700 Performance Points</color>; executing a <color=#FFAF2C>Shutdown</color> on Kusarikku's <Term:2000003></Term> grants <color=#FFAF2C>2000 Performance Points</color>.
